text:
miguel: Hey team — PR #8270 is green locally but CI keeps failing on ubuntu-latest e2e. Need a rebase slot? There's a deploy freeze tomorrow 12:00-18:00 UTC. Should we wait for the rebase window or force-merge if rerun passes? https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8270

tara: What's failing exactly? which test/job?

miguel: Failing job: `e2e/2026/ubuntu-latest` — log excerpt:
```
AssertionError: expected 200 but got 502
at tests/e2e/session.test.js:142
```
Happens intermittently, looks like a backend race.

ci-bot: CI report for PR #8270 — latest run: failed (job: e2e/ubuntu-latest). Flakiness score: 0.38. Retry recommended. Use `/retest` to queue a rerun.

sandeep: I'll queue a rerun now. If it flakes again I'll do a targeted rerun on the e2e job only. ETA ~5m.

olivia: Heads up — deploy freeze starts tomorrow 12:00 UTC. If we can't get a green CI before the freeze, we should defer merge to the scheduled rebase window at 16:00 UTC. No force merges during freeze.

miguel: OK queued rerun. Quick question — if rerun passes before 12:00 UTC can we merge? Who can provide +1 if I push a tiny fix?

tara: I can approve once CI is green. Prefer to keep it in the 16:00 rebase slot if the flakiness persists. :+1: 

sandeep: Rerun finished — ubuntu-latest green but other runners show intermittent failures. Rerun history for last 3 runs: green, fail, green. My vote: hold for the 16:00 rebase window to avoid a rollback during freeze.

miguel: Thanks. Plan: hold this PR until the 16:00 UTC rebase window (epoch 1795051200). If we get sustained green (2 consecutive CI runs) before then we'll merge; otherwise we'll rebase + merge in the 16:00 slot. Assigning rebase slot and setting the PR to "awaiting-rebase". @tara please approve when you see sustained green. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tara: Will do.

ci-bot: Scheduled rerun information: queued at 1795012900, run id 9923.
